name: discount-escalation
description: Rep pushes a discount past the approval threshold; DICE moves the deal to PENDING_APPROVAL.
manualSteps: Log in as sales_manager in DealFlow360 and approve the resulting request via the Approvals screen (or POST /api/approvals/{id}/approve) — granting an approval is a DICE-internal decision, not something OEEG simulates.

To see the resulting approval snapshot get invalidated by a material change, apply another POST /api/deals/{id}/discount to this same deal afterward — see docs/decision-contract.md's 'Approval snapshot / reapproval' section for the verified example. Not automated as a scenario here because it genuinely requires the manual approval step above to happen in between two OEEG-triggered changes.
